profile.ja: 五車学園に通う学生対魔忍。影遁の術使いで、影を操る事でその影の持ち主を動かす力を持つ。力ではその術に抵抗できず、どんな怪力の持ち主でも動きに抗う事はできない。ただ影を操れる範囲は狭く、高位魔族やトップクラスの対魔忍のような強い相手には足止め程度が精いっぱいである。敵を操ったり拘束するだけでなく、自身の影を操る事で通常不可能な機動を可能にするような戦法も使う。良く言えば真面目、悪く言えば頭が硬いタイプでおふざけや冗談を嫌う性格だが、非常に努力家で、発現当初は微弱だった自身の忍法を努力でここまで使いこなせる様になった。その実力は皆認めていて、性格は真逆だが同じ影遁の術使いとして井河さくらと比較される事が多い。本人もさくらの実力に憧れ、尊敬しているが、その上で実力差に才能の違いを感じてしまい落ち込むこともある。
profile.en: She is a Taimanin student at Gosha Academy, a practitioner of the Shadow Escape technique, which allows her to manipulate shadows and control the movements of those whose shadows she manipulates. No one can resist this technique with brute force, regardless of their physical strength. However, the range of shadows she can manipulate is limited, and against powerful opponents like high-ranking demons or top-class Taimanin, she can only manage to slow them down. She not only uses her technique to manipulate or restrain enemies but also to perform impossible maneuvers by manipulating her own shadow. She is a serious and hardworking person who dislikes joking around, but her dedication has allowed her to master her initially weak ninja techniques. Her abilities are recognized by everyone, and she is often compared to Igawa Sakura, another Shadow Escape practitioner, despite their vastly different personalities. Mikage Koume admires and respects Igawa Sakura's strength, but sometimes feels discouraged by the difference in their abilities.

text.ja: はじめまして、御影小梅と申します。さくら先生ほどではありませんが、影遁使いの一人として、必ずや隊に貢献してみせましょう
text.en: Nice to meet you, I'm Mikage Koume. I may not be as skilled as Professor Sakura, but as a Shadow Escape practitioner, I'll do my best to contribute to the team.

text.ja: お疲れさまです、隊長。ええ、任務の下調べと準備を。かを知り己を知れば――と言いますからね、情報は大事な武器です
text.en: You're working hard, Captain. Yes, I'm doing some research and preparation for our mission. As they say, "know your enemy and know yourself," so information is a valuable weapon.

text.ja: 隊長、あまり言いたくはありませんが……なんですか、この雑誌は。任務の妨げになりそうな要因を、持ち込まないでもらえますか
text.en: Captain, I don't want to say this, but... what's with this magazine? Could you please refrain from bringing in anything that might hinder our mission?

text.ja: 数日過ごしてわかりましたが、この隊はずいぶんと規律が緩いようですね。その責任の一端は、ほかでもない隊長にあるかと思うのですが
text.en: Captain, I've noticed that the discipline in this team is quite lax. I think some of the responsibility for that lies with you, the captain.

text.ja: 隊長！　なんですか、この部屋の惨状は！　物を散らかさない、だしたものは片づける！　子供でもできることですよ！
text.en: Captain! What's with the state of this room? Don't leave your things scattered around, and clean up after yourself! Even a child can do that!

text.ja: 若くして隊長になった、優秀な人だと信じていたのに……いえ、優秀は優秀なのですが……あまりにも弛んでいます、隊長は！
text.en: I believed you were a talented and young captain, but... well, you're certainly talented, but you're way too relaxed.

text.ja: 私の影遁は、影による肉体操作――といったところでしょうか。影を動かすことで、肉体を同じように動かすのです。まだまだ拙いですが
text.en: My Shadow Escape technique allows me to manipulate physical movements through shadows. By moving the shadow, I can move the corresponding body part. I'm still not very skilled at it, though.

text.ja: いまのところ、影遁は自身の操作、攻撃の回避などに使っていますが……いずれは、攻撃でも活躍させたいものです
text.en: For now, I'm using my Shadow Escape technique for self-manipulation and evading attacks, but... I hope to use it for offense as well someday.

text.ja: す、するわけないでしょう！　影遁であなたを動かして、自分が感じるように腰を遣わせるだなんてっ……しませんから、普通に動いてください！
text.en: D-don't be ridiculous! I'd never use my Shadow Escape technique to control you and make you move in a way that... that makes me feel something! Just move normally, please!

text.ja: これで、満足ですかっ……うっ、くぅっっ……あぁぁっ、そうっ、そうですっ！　この腰遣いが、一番っ……オマンコ、気持ちいいですっっ！
text.en: Are you satisfied now... ugh, ah, ah... yes, yes, this is it! This movement is the best... my pussy feels so good!
